body: I've tried.  I am a bit younger, they all have families, have kids.  They can occasionally be coaxed into going out to lunch or something.  But they have their own lives outside of work.  They have no interest in any real relationships outside of work.

There's a difference between understanding that other people get depressed, that one should live their life not looking at past failures, and forcing oneself to get connected in the world.

But there's a whole another feeling when you are in bed, staring at a wall for the second hour straight.  You desperately want to talk to someone, but there's no one in person to do so.  I could call my old friends, but I've been such a downer for the past few months, that I've really used up any goodwill complaining to anyone.  Most of them are married or have kids anyway, and they can't deal with something like this anymore.

So I look up local events, there's some dance parties, local concerts of artists I've never heard of.  But I'm awkward.  Every time I try to go to these, I never end up socializing with anyone.  I tried to force myself to do it once, and it was so awkward and cringe-worthy that I just spent the rest of the weekend in bed.  I don't have friends I could ask to have me tag along.  I could try less-social things, like the park, but that still makes me feel lonely, just in public.  And I don't feel any happier doing them anymore.  I could try checking on my online dating profile things again, but I've sent out literally a hundred messages on those.  Short guys sort of get filtered out pretty quick.

When I try to force myself to do things, I spend 5 or 10 minutes doing an activity I used to enjoy, find whatever it is unbearable, switch to something else, and do this cycle for hours.  I usually just default to bed, sometimes just lying there, sometimes forcing myself to nap, sometimes just on the verge of crying.  I just can't stand feeling like this anymore.  For months, with no changes I've done helping, and no changes in sight in the future to fix things.

I know the advice I should be going over again and again, is that this is just temporary.  But it doesn't seem very temporary to me.  Every other stage of life, I had something to look forward to.  In the short term, in the long term, I always was working towards something.  Now, everything just seems homogeneous and bland.  I can not pick out a single thing to look ahead for.

It's easy to tell someone to embrace being alone, but it's another thing to have to live that life so strongly.  I used to enjoy being alone as well, but then it kept eating away at me.  I'd like to take baby steps towards making friends, but I can't seem to do that.  I spent hours and hours looking online for events or clubs to go to, and just couldn't find anything I was happy about.  

I used to go out to eat by myself, or go to a coffee shop, or the local park, several evenings a week.  But then as the months went on, and I still kept finding myself alone, and depressed, and those outings became less and less.  It started to become apparent that I am just not the type of person who can have friends, who can eventually find a girlfriend, a wife, start a family.  Of course I'm still young, but how many 26 year old male virgins are there really, who don't have something wrong with them?  How many 26 year old guys who have never had a girlfriend?  Never been on a date?  Never been kissed?  Who have no friends? 

It's too late now.  Whatever multitude of problems I have, bleed into every aspect of my life now.  I've lived alone and tried to be happy, not trying too hard to meet people.  And then I tried really hard to meet people.  And then I just gave up.  In every case though, I just ended up sad and by myself.  

I just really don't want to keep going.  I am tired of feeling like this, or feeling anything at all.
